statement: Clean no-holder Cemu 29f2f1f ARM64 native Wiimote motionplus-nunchuk comparison with caller EEPROM and synthetic imported MP/Nunchuk calibration passes the base EEPROM read. All 18 native A40020/16 reads succeed: 17 returned payloads match the caller Nunchuk block and one matches the MP block first half. Native identity observations include Nunchuk before the first calibration request; concurrent kernel mapping can change the addressed device, so reply counts are not a sole-actor interpretation oracle. Repeated initialization/report-mode activity continues. Decoded application motion remains unobserved; no physical calibration, accurate rate, whole-controller or wrong-bank-defect claim follows. No companion event holder exists at each arm preflight and the runner opens none; this does not unbind the kernel driver or isolate its protocol output.

applicability.revision: Original virtual model; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Clean no-holder preflight, kernel remains bound. Correct delivered calibration is distinct from decoded motion; no physical, calibrated-rate, radio or game promotion.
